size_basis: inline 254 nm reactor tube + control box at the 0.04 kW lamp class (A-M-428) (X-FARM sec3)

design.service: optional UV-C 254 nm loop sanitizer between the biofilter and the growbeds; AQUA_BYPASS normally engaged
design.basis: A-M-428; A-M-427 (food-safety mode); TECHTREE agriculture.aquaponics (produce food-safety note)
design.why_it_works: the nitrifying biofilm lives on the moving-bed media: post-media sterilization passes the nitrates and kills only sloughed/free cells
design.modes: normal = bypassed (growbed rhizosphere needs its microbial feed); food-safety mode = inline (A-M-427 greens/harvest); contamination response = inline
design.ozone_contingency: deep-clean with ozone fed from CRYO_O2, fish isolated, never in-line live: residual ozone is lethal to gills and biofilm
design.dose_class: 254 nm, 30-100 mJ/cm2 class for the loop flow; the 40 kg/d loop is trivial flow for a 0.04 kW lamp
design.failure_mode: lamp depletion or sleeve fouling: dose decays silently - the X-FARM-12 validation test is periodic, not one-shot

nozzles.service: nitrified water to the optional sanitizer (NO3- passes; sloughed cells die in food-safety mode)
sanitized loop water to the growbeds (food-safety/contingency mode)

material: SS304 reactor tube with a quartz UV sleeve, PP loop fittings, EPDM gasket class
holds: no AQS-PLAN-006 section 4 route class for class uv_sanitizer
